finalText:
**Repeats of a key within 5 minutes now drop.**

99 of 900 events dropped, matching the flap rate in `events.js`. Zero errors. Routing and quiet hours are unchanged for everything else.

`createState()` now returns `{ lastSentByKey: new Map() }`. Only real sends update the timer, so a dropped repeat does not extend the window. See [src/router.js:29](src/router.js:29).
